starter_files.contents:
# Text Sentiment Classifier

## Objective
Predict a sentiment label from text using a reproducible tokenization and sequence-model pipeline.

## Setup
Create a dedicated virtual environment and install a PyTorch build that matches your OS and hardware using https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/.

## Deliverables
- Reproducible implementation and configuration
- Tests for shapes, outputs, and at least one failure case
- Report with metrics, versions, data provenance, and limitations

## Safety and execution
Do not load untrusted serialized objects or expose unrestricted model execution as a public service. CodeLeaf does not provide a secure arbitrary-Python runner.

required_features: Use embeddings and a sequence model
Evaluate by class and inspect errors
stretch_features: Compare one alternative model or configuration with the same evaluation protocol.
Add structured experiment logs and a repeatable command-line entry point.
Test one realistic failure mode and document a rollback or recovery step.

tests.name: reproducibility and configuration
criteria: Dataset and preprocessing versions are documented.
The reported result can be reproduced with the README commands.

tests.name: functional smoke tests
criteria: Model input and output shapes are asserted.
One invalid input or restoration failure is tested.
The inference path uses evaluation mode and disables autograd where appropriate.

tests.name: quality and responsible use
criteria: Metrics fit the task and are reported on held-out data.
Known limitations and data provenance are documented.
Performance claims are supported by actual target-environment measurements.

review_method: Human review using milestone evidence, tests, and the 100-point rubric. Static checks do not replace executing the project in an isolated environment.
